name: slimlytics-promo-video
description: 30-second Slimlytics promo video, rendered with Remotion.

scripts.studio: npm run audio && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run audio && remotion render src/index.ts Promo out/slimlytics-promo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20 --x264-preset slow
scripts.poster: remotion still src/index.ts Poster out/slimlytics-promo-poster.jpg --image-format jpeg --jpeg-quality 80
scripts.publish: npm run render && npm run poster && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/slimlytics-promo.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 23 -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v high -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 128k -ar 48000 -t 30 -movflags +faststart ../frontend/static/video/slimlytics-promo.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/slimlytics-promo-poster.jpg -vf scale=1280:-1 -q:v 5 ../frontend/static/video/slimlytics-promo-poster.jpg
